native_stochastic.objective_definition: Weighted FSD/SSD/TSD of the complete four-week self-financing policy cumulative-return distribution against all72 buy-and-hold asset references and actual Current with cash, normalised by the actual augmented-network maximum degree. Subtract probability-weighted existing final-decision penalties; historical rows calibrate forecasts and feasibility, never become terminal outcomes.
native_stochastic.search_definition: Feasible structured joint-policy proposals and coordinate neighbourhood search; all node variables and all terminal outcomes explicit; no global-optimality certificate.

rows.status: heuristic attained-policy estimates on complete native law
rows.definition: Maximisation gaps in the same joint terminal-distribution objective, including penalties. EV replaces price paths by their probability means; EEV fixes its initial vector and searches feasible recourse on the complete law. WS allows future-informed pathwise decisions and is scored as one weighted terminal distribution; infeasible informed paths retain the original feasible RP path. No per-leaf netSD averaging. Integer heuristic optima are not certified, so these are attained-policy estimates, not exact optimal EVPI/VSS.
